text:
Maya: Quick signal check — brought up opal-9b v1 last night, mixed int6/float16 build. Ran a 10k-sample smoke. Short-context perf looks fine but long-context summarization slips.
Gopal: Which slices are slipping? length or content-specific?
Maya: Long docs (5k–10k tokens) — ROUGE-L down ~4.5 pts on our summarization eval. <=512 token docs are essentially unchanged.
Sophie: Any changes to the KV-cache path? New quant kernels sometimes fall back to a different attention pipeline for big sequences.
Maya: Yeah, traces show repeated cache flushes once sequence >3k; kv-hit rate drops and runtime falls into a safer but slower path.
Ara: FYI the mixed int6 runtime currently disables the large fused attention kernel for memory safety — that raises compute and tail latency for long runs.
James: Can you quantify latency impact? Product needs 99p < 800ms for summaries.
Maya: 99p moved from ~620ms on baseline to ~980ms on the long-doc canary. Short docs unchanged.
Gopal: So cost wins for most traffic but long-doc SLO is violated. How frequent are long summaries in GTN traffic?
Sophie: Sampled prod traces: ~7% of requests exceed 3k tokens but they account for ~28% of token spend.
Maya: Quick unit-econ: baseline (13b fp16) ≈ $0.045 / 1k tokens. opal-9b int6 ≈ $0.035 / 1k overall, BUT because of the fallback path the effective cost for long-docs is ≈ $0.06 / 1k and latency spikes.
Ara: Makes sense. Proposal: hybrid routing — int6 for <=3k, route >3k to 13b fp16. Keeps cost wins and preserves SLO for long form.
James: Product prefers a single API but is okay with transparent routing if user-visible latency stays stable.
Maya: Suggested rollout:
- Canary: 2% traffic hybrid routing (int6 if <=3k, else 13b fp16)
- Monitors: per-slice ROUGE-L, 99p latency, errors, kv-cache hit
- Acceptance: ROUGE-L regression <=1.0 pt on core slices, 99p latency <800ms
- Auto-rollback: if thresholds violated, revert to 100% 13b
Gopal: Add a synthetic long-doc perf probe (every minute) to detect cache-path regressions quickly.
Sophie: Scorecard fields to surface in eval UI: model_name, quant_profile, slice_name, pct_tokens_per_call, token_cost_per_1k, rougel_delta, p99_latency_ms, rollout_pct, verdict. Keep schema machine-readable.
Ara: Ops needs a routing flag: allow-hybrid-opal9b=true. Gate rollout to staging and a team env first.
James: GTN blurb for PMs: "Recommend opal-9b int6 for standard interactions (<=3k tokens). Route long-form summarization to 13b fp16 until cache-fused kernel or int6 long-path is fixed. Roll hybrid behind a feature flag with real-time health probes."
Maya: Next steps: I'll add the synthetic probe PR (ETA EOD), Sophie will draft the scorecard schema, Ara will add the routing flag, Gopal will prepare final short vs long eval slices and compute unit-econ for GTN pricing doc.
Sophie: Also propose an int4 microbake for short-context only (<=1k) at 1% to test cost upside without hurting QA.
Maya: Adding int4 microbake to the canary checklist.
James: Keep PMs in the loop. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Canary deployment scheduled: hybrid routing 2% traffic at 2026-03-24T18:00Z
Maya: Thanks — will post first-minute synthetic probe numbers back here.
